injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

manifestations.description: pain in her knee and leg
cannot stand for a prolonged period of time
cannot carry heavy objects (or her own daughter who is 4 years old)
memory is not as good as before
tenderness at the right infrapatellar tendon and the fracture site
unilateral muscular atrophy of the right thigh and calf
decreased left wrist strength; power grip of 20 kg over left hand and 26 kg over right side respectively
could not fully weight bear over right lower limb because of pain
mild residual stiffness at the ankle
mild residual tenderness at the distal end of the plate (right forearm)

treatments_received: open reduction and internal fixation for right ulna fracture (3/3/03)
open reduction and internal fixation for right malleolus fracture (3/3/03)
closed reduction and plaster for left distal radius fracture (3/3/03)
closed reduction and intramedullary nailing for right tibial fracture (3/3/03)
exploration and bone grafting for right tibial fracture (19/8/03)
treatments_future: removal of the intramedullary nail in right tibia
removal of plates in the right forearm
further course of physiotherapy treatment aiming at strengthening of the muscles of the right thigh and right calf (two months)

losses.description: Cannot run or jump; cannot stand for a prolonged period; will not be able to walk long distance especially when carrying heavy weight

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks

Scarring and stiffness of the ankle; surgical scar over the infra-patella tendon

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
